note.catalogueIsTenant: Asset types are your organization's own. Nothing is supplied with the product.
note.tagIsIdentity: The asset tag identifies the item and cannot be changed once it is registered.
note.serialOptional: A serial number is optional, and no two assets may share one.
note.statusIsService: The status says whether the item is in service. It does not say who is holding it.
note.custodyNotBuilt: Recording receipt by the employee, passing an asset directly to another person, and cancelling or correcting a record are not part of this release.
note.noCustodyStatus: There is no issued or returned status on an asset. Whether it is held is recorded as custody, separately.
note.retiredIsFinal: A retired asset stays retired. Nothing brings it back into service.
note.noDelete: Assets are retired, never deleted, and asset types are deactivated rather than removed.
note.locationIsNote: Where it is is a note you write, not a link to an organizational unit.
note.purchaseIsNote: The purchase reference is a note you write. No value, cost or depreciation is held here.
note.noValuation: This system holds no asset value, cost or depreciation. That is not what it is for.
note.noCondition: Condition is not recorded in this release.
note.noDeduction: No payroll deduction is produced or authorized here.
note.custodyIsPeriod: Each record covers one period: who held the asset, from when, and until when.
note.oneHolder: An asset can be held by one employment at a time.
note.returnedIsFinal: Once a return is recorded it cannot be edited or deleted.
note.noTransfer: Passing an asset straight from one person to another is not part of this release. Record the return, then issue it again.
note.noAcknowledgement: Recording an issue is not the employee’s acknowledgement. Acknowledgement is not part of this release.
note.custodyNotStatus: An asset that is out is still in service. Whether it is held is shown here, not in its status.
note.retirementBlocked: An asset that is still out cannot be retired. Record its return first.
note.employmentNotPerson: Custody is recorded against an employment. No personal details are held here.
note.noSelfService: Employees cannot view or acknowledge their own custody in this release.

rejection.category_code_malformed: A code may use lower-case letters, digits and hyphens only.
rejection.category_name_incomplete: An asset type needs a name in both English and Arabic.
rejection.category_sequence_invalid: The order must be a whole number, zero or more.
rejection.asset_tag_too_long: That asset tag is too long.
rejection.serial_number_too_long: That serial number is too long.
rejection.location_note_too_long: That location note is too long.
rejection.purchase_reference_too_long: That purchase reference is too long.
rejection.asset_transition_refused: An asset cannot move that way from where it is now.
rejection.issued_on_malformed: Give the issue date as YYYY-MM-DD.
rejection.issued_on_in_future: An asset cannot be issued with a future date.
rejection.returned_on_malformed: Give the return date as YYYY-MM-DD.
rejection.returned_on_in_future: A return cannot be recorded with a future date.
rejection.returned_before_issued: An asset cannot be returned before it was issued.
rejection.custody_not_open: This custody has already been returned.

conflict.category_code_taken: An asset type already uses that code.
conflict.category_inactive: This asset type is no longer in use.
conflict.asset_tag_taken: An asset already uses that tag.
conflict.serial_number_taken: An asset already has that serial number.
conflict.asset_already_in_custody: This asset is already held by somebody.
conflict.asset_not_available: This asset is not available to be issued.
conflict.asset_in_custody: This asset is still held by somebody and cannot be retired.
